rationale: Record parsing the browser capture's --width option, which existed only inside the error string that advertised it, so the one remedy a negative-overflow refusal named could not be followed. A pinned width authors the page at a width the caller knows the layout resolves at and skips the automatic correction, and the refusal now reports the measurement and both layouts that survive that correction instead of naming a flag that cannot move anchored content. Watch-only: no capture, import, or rendering authority is transferred, and every existing invocation keeps its behaviour because the launcher passes --initial-width and never --width.
tests: an explicit --width resolves a layout the bounded correction cannot
an unreachable left overflow names its cause, not a phantom flag
